description: Generate procedural seeded SVG avatars — same seed always gives the same face. Shuffle, or download as SVG/PNG.

faqs.a: A seeded random generator picks face shapes, skin tones, hair, eyes, mouths, and accessories — fully procedural, no images.
Yes — type any seed word and the same avatar is generated every time.
Download the vector SVG or a raster PNG (512×512).
Shuffle rolls a random seed for a brand-new face.

howto: Type a seed word (or leave blank).
title: Avatar Generator
